name: Brutal Hauberk
summary: Brutal Hauberk marks the culmination of an arduous rite of passage for Horde warriors in the Barrens. After gathering rare materials and proving their mettle against dangerous foes across the lands, warriors present their bounty to the reclusive smith Thun'grim Firegaze. In return, he hammers out a rugged suit of mail designed to withstand the harshest battles.

sections.title: A Smith's Masterpiece
sections.body: Perched along the craggy hills of the northern Barrens, Thun'grim Firegaze does not forge armor for just anyone. The reclusive orc demands that aspiring warriors travel far and wide to harvest tough beast parts, rare metal, and alchemical reagents before he even lights his bellows. The finished hauberk is not merely protective gear; it is an enduring badge of endurance and grit recognized by veteran fighters throughout the Horde.

sections.title: Forged in Hardship
sections.body: Thun'grim's task is purposefully punishing. True Horde arms and armor are expected to bear the sweat and blood of their wearer from the moment of their inception. Handing over the finished Brutal Hauberk, the smith offers no flowery praise—only the expectation that the armor will be proven in brutal combat and return bearing stories of blood and honor.

faq.answer: The Brutal Hauberk is a sturdy chestpiece custom-crafted by the orc blacksmith Thun'grim Firegaze. It serves as the crowning reward for Horde warriors who prove their combat prowess by gathering rare materials across several dangerous lands.

Thun'grim Firegaze is a reclusive veteran smith who resides atop a mountain spur in the northern Barrens, just east of the road between the Crossroads and Orgrimmar. He tests emerging warriors and smiths them specialized armor when they prove their worth.

faq.q: Why does Thun'grim require so much effort before crafting the armor?
faq.answer: Horde warrior tradition values hardship as much as martial skill. Thun'grim believes that high-grade mail is wasted on anyone who has not shed their own blood and toiled to acquire the rare components necessary to forge it.

faq.q: Where does this quest chain lead next?
faq.answer: This quest represents the final step of the Brutal Armor trials. Once Thun'grim presents you with the finished hauberk, his work for you is complete, leaving you to wear the armor into battle across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms.

faq.q: Is the Brutal Hauberk quest available to the Alliance?
faq.answer: No. The Brutal Hauberk is exclusively a Horde trial. Alliance warriors undergo a distinct martial rite involving the smiths of Ironforge and the surrounding dwarven territories to forge their own signature armor.

faq.q: Where in the Barrens can Thun'grim be found?
faq.answer: Thun'grim dwells on a high ridge in the northern Barrens, situated south of the Southfury River and slightly east of the main mountain road leading north toward Durotar.

angles.text: The Brutal Hauberk is a milestone achievement for young Horde warriors, representing the transition from raw recruit to a hardened combatant outfitted in bespoke mail.
Crafted from blood-earned trophies gathered from Kalimdor's wilds, the hauberk reflects the Horde's core virtues of martial self-reliance and strength.
Watching Thun'grim work provides an education in traditional orcish smithing, where martial spirit and resilience are hammered directly into the steel.
